feeds.title: Lafayette Lacemakers
feeds.description: Lafayette Lacemakers, Inc., is a charter of the International Organization of Lace, Inc. Our goal is to educate and develop an appreciation for lace the fine art of lacemaking.

feeds.title: Alessandrina machine knitting and more » Lace
feeds.description: Hello! I am Alessandrina. I am interested in nearly all things fiber. My main focus is on machine knitting. I construct my wearables using a variety of on and off the loom techniques to produce one of a kind and limited edition items.

feeds.title: A passion for knitted Lace
feeds.description: Hi! I am MoniqueB. Fine lacework is really my passion. I not only knit on commission but also make designs for you to knit.
